descriptions: In the cardiology division, reviewed 410 charts for a study of 30-day readmissions after heart failure discharge; first-author poster presented at a national cardiology meeting, Nov 2025
Built the REDCap database and data dictionary the study team now uses for two follow-up projects
Ran the statistical analysis in R and drafted the methods section of the study manuscript, submitted to a cardiology journal and under review
Run Saturday intake for about 35 uninsured patients and coordinate eight student volunteers per shift
Started a blood pressure follow-up list that brought 60% of hypertensive patients back within a month
Responded to about 20 calls per 24-hour shift on a two-person basic life support crew
Trained four new EMTs on the stretcher, radio and patient care report system
Alpha Omega Alpha Honor Medical Society
Research: REDCap, R, chart review, abstract writing
